Explicit nonstop return SFO/HKG service and flight directions; cabin-deployment days are not used as all operating days.
Names American-operated routes between JFK/LAX, JFK/SFO and BOS/LAX. Equipment-introduction dates are not route start dates and are not stored as service validity.
Flightplan lists Lufthansa-operated flights both ways and separately labels UA-operated flights both ways. Only the stated operating airline is indexed, not the marketing number.
Singapore Airlines states Taipei is served nonstop from its Singapore hub. Used only for the SIN-TPE directional route; no exact flight identity is inferred.

Singapore Airlines' current Singapore-origin page explicitly names selected cities as direct/non-stop from SIN and exposes airport identities on the same destination surface. GCMP retains only those individually named non-stop examples that resolve to one exact airport IATA code. Multi-airport city aggregates including Beijing, Tokyo, London, Kuala Lumpur and Sydney are withheld; destinations not individually listed in the explicit non-stop examples are also withheld even if branded SQ elsewhere. Cape Town is an explicit negative control because its route page says SIN-CPT operates one-stop via JNB. No reverse direction is inferred.

Qantas' current international flight network lists active bidirectional 'Between' routes and explicitly labels one-stop services with 'via'. Only pairs listed without 'via' are used as nonstop route evidence; no codeshare, QantasLink or domestic denominator is inferred.

Air New Zealand's Auckland page publishes exact-code nonstop inbound routes from WLG, CHC, ZQN, DUD and IVC and also identifies current inbound international nonstop service. These directions are used independently rather than inferred from outbound services.

Current Air New Zealand Asia page explicitly states nonstop Auckland service to Bali, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Singapore, Taipei and Tokyo. Future Christchurch services are not counted before their announced start.

Air India official international connectivity map says it flies nonstop to 41 destinations and draws bidirectional arrows between each listed overseas airport and the named Indian airport(s). It is a broad route-universe snapshot, not a current dated timetable; later current advisories and route launches override it where applicable.

SWISS' current nonstop flightplan lists LX176 ZRH-SIN and LX177 SIN-ZRH without a partner-operator label, while separately marking LX9000 as operated by SQ. Only the SWISS-operated directional pair is retained.
LOT confirms direct WAW-SFO-WAW service from 2026-05-06 through 2026-10-22 and explicitly gives outbound LO35/LO37 plus return LO36/LO38. Both directions retain that finite published validity window.

LOT's current first-flight page explicitly calls the listed services inaugural LOT Polish Airlines flights and gives directional LOT flight identities for WAW-ALA / ALA-WAW, WAW-SFO / SFO-WAW, GDN-BRU / BRU-GDN, GDN-OSL / OSL-GDN, and KRK-ROME/MAD/BCN with their returns. Exact airport codes are accepted only where the additional airline-owned sources below resolve them.

Air China's current check-in guidance explicitly identifies Air China-operated international flights from Shenzhen to Frankfurt. Used as exact SZX-FRA operating-route evidence only; city-level Beijing/Shanghai examples are not expanded because of multi-airport ambiguity.

AEGEAN's current flight-status board exposes exact airport pairs and distinguishes rows labeled Aegean Airlines from OlympicAir. GCMP retains only directions explicitly shown as Aegean Airlines on the reviewed current board; OA rows are excluded and no reverse direction is inferred unless separately shown.

Royal Jordanian's Quick Reference Timetable No.473 is explicitly valid 01Sep-30Sep 2026 and publishes exact airport codes, directional flight identities and special From/To AQJ/ADJ rows. Its legend marks one-stop services with * and RO/GF/WY-operated codeshare aircraft with #; the reviewed September flight rows contain no # marker and YYZ is the only * one-stop city row. GCMP retains only exact direct legs that can be represented without decomposing the YYZ through service.
Oman Air announces direct Muscat-Singapore service starting 2026-07-02. Both directions are retained as current route-only evidence.
Alaska's exact-date status for flight 68 identifies SFO-SEA and explicitly says Operated by Alaska Airlines. Used as current AS operating-route evidence.
Alaska's exact-date status for flight 680 identifies SEA-SFO and explicitly says Operated by Alaska Airlines. Used independently for the reverse directional route.

Croatia Airlines states web check-in applies to scheduled flights operated by Croatia Airlines and lists exact OU identities including OU380 SPU-FCO, OU384 DBV-FCO, OU300 DBV-ATH and OU4352 SPU-IST. Used as operator-boundary corroboration alongside current direct-route timetable pages.
Croatia Airlines' current Croatian-language Athens timetable separately labels DBV-ATH and SPU-ATH as direct while ZAG-ATH is via Dubrovnik. Used for independently directional reverse-route evidence.
Croatia Airlines' current Croatian-language Copenhagen timetable lists ZAG-CPH and SPU-CPH as direct services and separately labels DBV-CPH as via Zagreb.

Croatia Airlines' current London-bound timetable publishes direct ZAG-LHR, SPU-LHR, SPU-LGW, PUY-LHR and ZAD-LHR services with 2026 seasonal bounds where applicable; DBV-LHR is explicitly via Zagreb and excluded.
Croatia Airlines' current Croatian-language timetable independently publishes SPU-DUB for 2026-05-10 through 2026-10-11.

Croatia Airlines' current Rome-bound timetable explicitly labels SPU-FCO and DBV-FCO as direct and ZAG-FCO as via Split/Dubrovnik. Exact OU380/OU384 operator identities are independently corroborated by the current operated-flight check-in source.

Asiana's operational-routes notice lists current 2026 ICN-JFK/LAX/SFO/SEA services with exact OZ flight identities. GCMP retains selected directional route evidence only; detailed date exceptions remain outside this route-first tranche.

Asiana's current operating-schedule notice lists exact OZ flight-number pairs for a broad 2026 network. GCMP retains only airport pairs whose IATA identity is explicit in the notice. The page itself says other routes may exist and points users to schedule search, so this source is deliberately partial and cannot establish an OZ denominator.

Shenzhen Airlines' current 2026 international coupon terms require flights sold by ZH and actually operated by ZH, explicitly exclude codeshares, and enumerate applicable directional international routes for 2026-08-23..09-23 and 2026-10-04..12-31. GCMP retains the exact airport-resolved routes only; coupon dates do not become recurring schedule evidence.

2026-Q2 worldwide ADS-B-derived passenger-flight observations. GCMP retains only callsign-validated directional routes with at least two known non-cargo passenger-config observations; this is recent-operation evidence, not a September timetable.
